core_obligations: H3: Complete existence and structure of relaxed BV minimizers with partial free boundary, beyond the already qualified convexification result2278. Given the direct method and cited interior minimal-graph regularity, the author still has to construct countably iterated symmetric Plateau replacements along free arcs without energy increase, control traces at convex boundaries, rule out partial contact with a curved Dirichlet arc by replacement competitors (including infinitely many contact components), handle the all-or-nothing straight-segment contact alternative, and obtain a minimizer with finitely many disjoint analytic free curves. The new counted goal is full boundary/free-boundary structure and regular existence, not a second copy of convexification. The general convex-domain relaxed theorem and strictly convex-domain classical corollary are one result family.
